local_interfaces.finding: Body has name and folder_token only; empty parent selects caller root. Bot auto-grant occurs after creation.
Reads existing target settings, not future-child effective policy.
Target membership must be assessed together with link sharing and applicable inheritance.
Create has no atomic privacy field; external_access=false does not close organization link sharing. Post-create patch cannot establish privacy before creation.

bounded_discovery.searched: Frozen catalog method/resource names and method descriptions for default/permission combinations and 权限默认 or 默认权限.

bounded_discovery.limit: Not proof that no such API exists outside the shipped catalog. Public UI guidance is not an API guarantee.

unverified_prerequisites: Effective current user, tenant, and user/app identity binding.
Current effective member creation policy, including applicable overrides and completed propagation.
Authoritative exact-operation API rule establishing account-only visibility at creation, with applicable destination inheritance and policy precedence.
For an existing destination, complete account-only membership plus public and inherited settings.
rejected_shortcuts: Treating an invisible personal-folder tree or absent invited collaborators as proof all link access is closed.
Using an existing private document, root metadata, or parent ACL alone as proof of unborn-child privacy.
Creating first and reading or restricting permissions afterward.
conclusion: No verified current-account-only precreation route is established by these sources without additional account-policy and API-specific evidence. A user-supplied destination alone would not resolve an unproved creation rule.
